semantics.O: Source ordinary availability/presence candidate only. Requires separately verified unlock, relationship, rescue, story, rank and other state guards. May include scripted introduction rather than free choice.
semantics.D: Conditional holiday invitation, not ordinary rank-up availability. Exact invitation eligibility and received/accepted message state still required.
semantics.-: Not available according to this source in this entity/date/slot. Not independently verified impossibility.
semantics.emptyOrUndefined: Unknown; never coerce to false or true.
semantics.outsideWindowOrMissingEntity: Unknown, not unavailable. Fool, Death and Judgement are absent from the calendar, not given all-false schedules.
semantics.globalFreeSlot: Never infer from presence, absence or all-negative rows.
semantics.availableField: Always null intentionally; availabilityClaim is a source claim, not computed player-state eligibility.

uncertainties.detail: Actual empty source cell retained unknown.
Wiki 453 calls this forced after-school introduction. O cannot establish optional free choice.
Justice O starts 04-28 while Wiki earliest start is 05-07. Strength O starts 04-25 while Wiki earliest start is 04-24. Do not derive unlock date from first O.
Aqiu availability table says Sun 08-23 and Devil Hermit rank 3; Wiki says Sun earliest 08-09 and Devil Hermit rank 4. This extraction does not import Aqiu unlock claims.
Hierophant and Hanged Man require rescue-state handling independently; source date symbols do not encode player rescue state.
Weekday match is limited corroboration only. Calendar closures, exact event-slot legality and D conditions remain unverified. Missing Wiki invitation is discrepancy, not proof of invalidity.
All non-social-link columns retained raw. Episode numbers, ranges, names and Tartarus markers are not executable actions or free-slot claims.

Aqiu dedicated holiday invitation table lists Lovers 08-03 and 08-09, while its calendar matrix has explicit dashes and Wiki 453 does not list those two invitations. Preserved raw matrix dashes with this unresolved source-internal discrepancy; never silently change them to D.

tests.reason: Two Lovers dates 08-03 and 08-09 occur only in dedicated invitation table; source disagreement recorded without mutating observed matrix.

extractionMethod.selection: Source tables 1 through 20 zero-based; first ten daytime, next ten nighttime mapped to evening
extractionMethod.cellText: stripped DOM text_content; empty string preserved
extractionMethod.dateParsing: Explicit source month/day to canonical 2009/2010 axis; source weekday independently checked
extractionMethod.columnDisambiguation: Headers asserted by exact full position in every table. No lookup by ambiguous abbreviations.
extractionMethod.sourceSnapshotsRetainedExternally: Snapshot hashes above; raw HTML snapshots are research inputs and not embedded in this rule artifact.
